scripts.buildRust: cargo rustc --features webgpu  --lib --manifest-path ./src/engine/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -C target-feature=+simd128,+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals && cd ./buildscript && cargo run
scripts.buildRust-prod: cargo rustc --features webgpu --release --lib --manifest-path ./src/engine/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -C target-feature=+simd128,+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals && cd ./buildscript && cargo run --release
scripts.build: tsc --project ./src/tsconfig.debug.json && tsc --project ./src/tsconfig.workers.json && npm run buildRust && npm run build-rollup-debug
scripts.build-prod-local: tsc --project ./src/tsconfig.json && tsc --project ./src/tsconfig.workers.json && npm run buildRust-prod && npm run build-rollup-prod
scripts.test: npm run test-unit && npm run test-integration && npm run test-wasm && npm run test-rust && npm run test-cypress
scripts.test-integration: npm run buildRust && start npx swa start && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js  --forceExit --detectOpenHandles --runInBand --silent=false --config=./src/jest.integration.config.cjs
scripts.test-rust: set RUST_BACKTRACE="1"&&cargo test --lib --workspace --manifest-path ./src/engine/Cargo.toml && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli && cd src/terramath && cargo test --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cd ../collider && cargo test --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.clean: pwsh -Command "rm *.tsbuildinfo; rm -r ./node_modules;rm -r ./.rollup.cache;rm -r ./wwwroot/js"; cargo clean --manifest-path ./src/engine/Cargo.toml; cargo clean --manifest-path ./buildscript/Cargo.toml; cargo clean --manifest-path ./src/terramath/Cargo.toml
